# Third-party files

- `matter.min.js`: [Matter.js](https://github.com/liabru/matter-js) 0.19.0 by Liam Brummitt, MIT License. Powers the throwable pile in the hero.
- `schibsted-grotesk.woff2`: [Schibsted Grotesk](https://github.com/schibsted/schibsted-grotesk) (Latin subset, weights 400–800) by Schibsted Media Group, SIL Open Font License 1.1.

Both are served from this site, so the page loads nothing from anyone else.
- `excalifont.woff2`: [Excalifont](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw) (Latin subset) by Excalidraw, based on Virgil, SIL Open Font License 1.1. Used for the handwritten notes in the hero.
